deckWinrateNote: Not shown directly; inferred from the site's up/down arrows (68.4 marked up, 67.0 marked down).
combosNote: User ruling 2026-09-25: 「可以高機率留的組合是：低語+侍僧；魔眼+殭屍；派對+buff」. Both halves in the opening hand both stay, over the win-rate bands. "role:X" matches any card describe.mjs roles() tags X; the cheapest match is kept.
